summary: Held-story records tidied after the 22:00 publish

editor_fail.why: The vote is still misreported. MercoPress says 'all 44 senators present out of 45': 44 were present and all voted for removal. PBS and CT Public both say unanimous. The story, standfirst, key point, timeline, main graphic and both covers (en '44 of 45 senators present', hi '45 में 44 मौजूद सीनेटर') say 44 of the 45 senators present voted to remove him, which still implies one vote against. Separately, the November 9 indefinite strike by a teachers' union of 40,000+ members (in the body, the timeline, the 'upcoming' line and the homepage This Week panel) is in none of the three listed sources (MercoPress, PBS, CT Public).
editor_fail.fix: In EN and HI, change every mention to 'removed unanimously by all 44 senators present in the 45-member Senate' (Hindi: 'सीनेट में मौजूद सभी 44 सीनेटरों ने सर्वसम्मति से हटाया'). Change the graphic and cover stat to 'Unanimous' with the label 'all 44 senators present voted to remove him', then rebuild the main picture and both covers. Remove the teachers' union strike from the body, the timeline and 'upcoming' (which also takes it off This Week), unless a source that reports it is added.
